7.4.2.24 Service 0x85 - ControlDTCSetting
An external test tool can request an ECU to either disable or enable DTC storage in the
ECUs error memory by sending a UDS Service 0x85 request with sub-function 0x01
("ON") or 0x02 ("OFF").
The ControlDTCSetting service in ISO 14229-1:2020 [9] allows the optional parame-
ter DTCSettingControlOptionRecord. The diagnostic server instance always supports
Manager
this parameter. This effectively means that a ControlDTCSetting service with or with-
out DTCSettingControlOptionRecord is processed in the same way.
As defined in
[SWS_Dcm_01399] the DTCSettingControlOptionRecord is limited to the one and only
0xFFFFFF value.
[SWS_Dcm_00249]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04159
⌈The Dcm module shall implement UDS Service ControlDTCSetting (0x85) to enable or
disable the storage of DTCs in the ECUs error memory.⌋
[SWS_Dcm_01399]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04159
⌈If the Dcm receives a ControlDTCSetting (0x85) service with DTCSettingControlOp-
tionRecord != 0xFFFFFF, the Dcm shall send a NRC 0x31 (RequestOutOfRange).⌋
[SWS_Dcm_01063]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04115
⌈On reception of UDS Service 0x85 with subfunction 0x01 (DTCSettingType "ON"), the
Dcm shall call Dem_EnableDTCSetting() with ClientId = Client Id for this Dcm instance
(see DcmDemClientRef).⌋
[SWS_Dcm_00783]
